questions.question: Why did Dabura have to kill his best friend?
questions.subject: Dabura Karaba/Synopsis

answer.item: Dabura was forced into being their champion because the chief placed a curse on Spejo, holding her hostage. Dura was selected as the representative for the Rumelians and Dabura had no choice but to kill his best friend.

questions.question: What did Dura ask Dabura to do before their duel?
questions.subject: Dabura Karaba/Synopsis

answer.item: Dura had one last request for Dabura, to protect the Rumelians.

questions.question: Who did Dabura reunite with when he returned to Earth?
questions.subject: Dabura Karaba/Synopsis

answer.item: he reunited with Yuka and Kyoko
